item.title: Air India flight to London crashes after takeoff from Ahmedabad; 242 Onboard
item.description: On June 12, 2025, Air India flight AI171 to London crashed shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad. The Boeing 787 had 242 people onboard. The aircraft went down in the Meghani Nagar area near the airport, triggering a massive fire and rescue operation - TheTalkStreet

item.title: Govt Launches ₹3,000 FASTag Annual Pass for Private Vehicles with 70% Toll Savings
item.description: The FASTag Annual Pass will launch on August 15 for private vehicles, priced at ₹3,000 per year or 200 toll trips, whichever comes first. It offers around 70% savings on toll charges and is valid only on NHAI-managed highways - TheTalkStreet

item.title: Kaanta Laga Fame Shefali Jariwala Dies at 42 After Sudden Cardiac Arrest in Mumbai
item.description: Shefali Jariwala, popularly known as the ‘Kaanta Laga’ girl and Bigg Boss 13 contestant, tragically passed away on June 27, 2025, in Mumbai at the age of 42 due to a cardiac arrest - TheTalkStreet

item.title: Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar Resigns Early Due to Health Problems
item.description: Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar resigned on July 21, 2025, due to health issues, following his doctor’s advice. He stepped down under Article 67(a) of the Constitution. In his message, he thanked President Murmu, Prime Minister Modi, ministers, and MPs, calling it an honour to serve - TheTalkStreet

item.title: Nitish Kumar ready to become Bihar’s Chief Minister for the 10th time
item.description: Nitish Kumar is set to take oath as Bihar Chief Minister for the tenth time, after resigning and dissolving the previous assembly - TheTalkStreet

item.title: Bollywood Legend Dharmendra Dies at 89, Industry Mourns End of an Era
item.description: Bollywood legend Dharmendra passes away at 89, leaving fans and the film industry in grief. Known for classics like Sholay, Chupke Chupke, and Phool Aur Patthar, his death marks the end of an iconic era in Indian cinema - TheTalkStreet

item.title: G20 Summit Ends with Key Global Decisions Amid U.S. Boycott
item.description: The G20 Summit in South Africa adopted a declaration despite a U.S. boycott, with PM Modi’s 6-point agenda on AI rules, critical minerals, and counter-terrorism gaining focus. The summit highlighted climate action, debt relief, and stronger Global South priorities - TheTalkStreet

item.title: Tejas Fighter Jet crashes at Dubai Air Show, Pilot dies
item.description: On 21 November 2025, India’s indigenous HAL Tejas fighter jet crashed during an aerobatic display at the Dubai Air Show at Al Maktoum International Airport, killing the Indian Air Force pilot on board- TheTalkStreet

item.title: Kolkata Feels Sharp Tremors as Bangladesh Hit by Strong Earthquake
item.description: A 5.7-magnitude earthquake struck near Dhaka, Bangladesh, at a shallow depth of about 10 km, causing strong tremors across Kolkata and several districts of West Bengal - TheTalkStreet

item.title: India vs South Africa: Intense ODI Clash Trends Nationwide
item.description: India and South Africa continue their high-intensity ODI battle as India secures a strong start with Kohli’s match-winning knock, while both teams prepare for a decisive clash in Raipur amid rising fan excitement - TheTalkStreet
